preserve: opaque semantic node and test identities
failure code, retry disposition, and cleanup outcome

normalize.subject: wall-clock timestamps
normalize.method: retain scenario-relative integer microseconds and ordered sample identity; remove absolute browser wall time

normalize.subject: opaque runtime process and timer references
normalize.method: replace first-seen values with stable process-N and timer-N labels without reordering

normalize.subject: browser-generated correlation, blob, and context IDs
normalize.method: replace first-seen values with stable typed labels while preserving equality and causality

normalize.subject: paint and cleanup duration
normalize.method: retain raw integer observations with environment fingerprint; never use normalization to pass a budget

normalize.subject: cumulative traces
normalize.method: deduplicate byte-identical repeated snapshots only; preserve every transition, error, and changed resource count

never_normalize: state, input, validation, DOM text, role, relationship, or focus result
error, stale-drop, orphan, leak, unexplained output, or cleanup failure
artifact bytes, hashes, source-map presence, or network path
